description: This file defines a SwiftUI view modifier for presenting an alert related to a deep link prompt in an iOS application. It manages user interactions for approving or declining an agent deep link prompt within the app's UI.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that displays an alert for deep link prompts, allowing the user to approve or decline an agent deep link.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the view with an alert that appears based on the current prompt binding.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: A binding to the current deep link prompt, used to control the alert's presentation.
